title: Record production output
intro: Enter what came off the line. Quantities use the plant’s units.
field.quantityHint: Write the number the way you normally do, for example {{example}}.
field.shrinkHint: Product lost on the line: spills, trim, samples.
field.temperatureHint: Core temperature at the end of the cook step.
field.notesHint: Anything the next shift should know.
validation.positive: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
validation.shrinkTooHigh: Shrink cannot be more than the quantity produced.
validation.dateFuture: The production date cannot be in the future.
validation.bestBeforeOrder: The best-before date must be after the production date.
success.title: Output recorded
server.title: The server did not accept this record
server.untranslated: Message from the server, not translated yet:
server.network: The server could not be reached. Nothing was saved.
server.unexpected: The answer from the server could not be read. Check the order before recording again.
